verdict.rationale: Paystack's own API reference provides code examples that users can copy into their code or run from the command line with cURL. Test keys allow those examples to be run safely against a test environment. There is no evidence that the reference is interactive, such as an in-browser 'try it' console where requests run directly from the docs page. Missing for 10: an interactive in-browser request runner, documentation of the reference's interactive features, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: You can copy and paste these examples into your own code or run them from the command line using cURL.
Use your test keys for development and testing, and your live keys for production.
